research.en: Ecological effects of urbanization and biodiversity conservation

bio.zh: 谷天赐，中共党员，北京师范大学自然资源专业博士生，研究城市化的近远程生态效应与生物多样性保护。博士导师为黄庆旭教授和何春阳教授。
bio.en: Tianci Gu is a PhD student in Natural Resources at Beijing Normal University and a member of the Communist Party of China. His research focuses on the local and distant ecological effects of urbanization and biodiversity conservation. His doctoral supervisors are Prof. Qingxu Huang and Prof. Chunyang He.

membership.en: Member of the Communist Party of China

homeBio.zh: 谷天赐是北京师范大学地理科学学部自然资源专业博士生，博士导师为黄庆旭教授和何春阳教授。
homeBio.en: Tianci Gu is a PhD student in Natural Resources at the Faculty of Geographical Science, Beijing Normal University. His doctoral supervisors are Prof. Qingxu Huang and Prof. Chunyang He.

homeBio.zh: 其研究关注城市化的近远程生态效应与生物多样性保护。后续将通过同等人口、不同空间形态的反事实比较，评估紧凑城市的节地与生态保护潜力。
homeBio.en: His research focuses on the local and distant ecological effects of urbanization and biodiversity conservation. His next step is to compare urban forms under the same population to assess the land-sparing and conservation potential of compact cities.

summary.zh: 谷天赐已发表第一或共同第一作者论文4篇、通讯或共同通讯作者论文8篇，另有导师为第一作者、谷天赐为学生第二作者的论文4篇；ESI高被引论文4篇。成果发表于npj Urban Sustainability、Earth's Future、Environmental Impact Assessment Review等期刊。
summary.en: Gu has published four first- or co-first-authored papers, eight corresponding- or co-corresponding-authored papers, and four papers with his supervisor as first author and Gu as second author. Four papers are ESI highly cited papers. His work has appeared in npj Urban Sustainability, Earth’s Future and Environmental Impact Assessment Review.

Four papers are ESI highly cited papers. His work has appeared in npj Urban Sustainability, Earth’s Future and other journals.

biography.en: Gu has led three university research projects and one commissioned project, and participated in National Key R&D Program tasks and NSFC international cooperation and general projects. He has received national, university and faculty awards. Two policy proposals were adopted by the Central Committee of the Jiusan Society and received directives from the Hubei Provincial Party Committee.

researchStatement.zh: 谷天赐的研究围绕城市化过程、生境影响路径和生物多样性响应展开，重点关注城市化如何通过不同路径改变生境质量。城市建设会直接改变生境；道路和污染向周边扩散，产生近程间接影响；消费与贸易则通过供应链，将远程间接影响传导到生产地。
researchStatement.en: Gu’s research examines how urbanization changes habitats and how biodiversity responds. He distinguishes the direct effects of urban construction, nearby indirect effects from roads and pollution, and distant indirect effects transmitted through consumption, trade and supply chains to production regions.

researchStatement.zh: 后续研究将从城市建设的直接影响入手，在同等人口、不同空间形态的反事实情景下，评估紧凑城市的节地与生态保护潜力。谷天赐将把近远程影响纳入统一框架，量化三类路径的贡献和叠加效应，识别关键区域，探索城内、周边与远端生产地的协同治理，并依托学会开展学术交流与政策咨询，服务新型城镇化、生物多样性保护与美丽中国建设。
researchStatement.en: Gu plans to compare counterfactual scenarios with the same population but different spatial forms, beginning with the direct effects of urban construction, to assess the land-sparing and conservation potential of compact cities. He will bring nearby and distant effects into a common framework, quantify the contributions and combined effects of these three pathways, identify key regions, and examine coordinated governance within cities, their surroundings and distant production regions. Through professional societies, he hopes to contribute academic exchange and policy advice supporting new-type urbanization, biodiversity conservation and the Beautiful China initiative.
